verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents multivariate flags with multiple weighted variants (A/B/n) and positions itself as managing both feature flags and remote config, so it clearly goes beyond plain booleans. However, the evidence never states which value types are supported, so serving strings, numbers or JSON is only implied by the 'remote config' claim. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of typed config values (string, number, JSON), SDK examples retrieving non-boolean values, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve multivariate flags and dynamic configuration values (strings, numbers, JSON), not just booleans

citations.quote: Multivariate flags let you define multiple variants with percentage weightings (A/B/n).
